text.이 PC의 로그로 토큰 사용량을 추정하고, 로그가 있는 출처를 기본으로: Estimates token usage from logs on this PC and turns on sources that have logs by default
text.세션 로그로 사용량을 셀 때 쓰는 설치자 설정입니다. 창·예산은 사용량: Server administrator settings for counting usage from session logs. Windows and budgets are set in the usage settings.
Id of the usage source made from logs. Left out if it overlaps a plugin source.
text.설정에서 생략한 키의 기본값 JSON 파일(상대 경로면 설정 파일 폴더: JSON file with defaults for keys left out of the settings (relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder). Leave empty for the built-in defaults.
text.이 PC에 로그 폴더가 있는 출처(기본: Claude Code 세션 로그: Turns on, read only, the sources whose log folder exists on this PC (default: Claude Code session logs). Values you set yourself win.
Turn this off if you don't want Claude Code logs read automatically.
text.자동 켜기 규칙 JSON 파일(상대 경로면 설정 파일 폴더 기준). 비우: JSON file with auto turn-on rules (relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder). Leave empty for the default rules.
text.첫 사용량 조회가 로그 수집을 기다리는 최대 시간(초). 0이면 기다리지: Maximum time (seconds) the first usage query waits for log collection. 0 means no wait.
text.로컬 로그의 토큰 합(5시간 블록·7일 이동 창 등, 창 정의는 설정 데: Token totals from local logs (5-hour blocks, 7-day rolling windows and so on; window definitions are settings data)
Left out = default windows (data). If several share an id, only the first is used.
Name that budgets and screens use to refer to this window.
A block counts the length from the first message; a rolling window counts back from now.
text.블록(첫 메시지부터 정한 길이): Block (set length from the first message)
Window length (hours). Added to the length in days if both are set.
Window length (days). Added to the length in hours if both are set.
Window name shown on the usage screen.
Short name shown in narrow places (status line and so on).
text.창 id → 토큰 수. 있으면 사용률 = 사용 토큰 / 예산. 없으면 사: Window id → number of tokens. If set, usage rate = used tokens / budget. Without it, there's no usage rate.
text.로그 추정 창에 사용률(%)을 보고 싶을 때 창마다 토큰 예산을 적습니다: Set a token budget per window to see a usage rate (%) for log-estimated windows.
text.로그 질의 필터(예: source, project, model). 시각·: Log query filter (for example source, project, model). Time and paging keys aren't used.
Kinds added to used tokens. Leave empty to add all four.
text.블록 경계를 정하려고 읽는 과거 범위. 창 길이보다 짧으면 창 길이를 쓴: How far back to read to find block boundaries. If shorter than the window length, the window length is used.
text.로컬 로그(기본: Claude Code 세션 로그)의 토큰 수를 창별로: An **estimate** that adds up tokens from local logs (default: Claude Code session logs) per window. Limits aren't published, so the usage rate shows only when you set `config.budgets` (window id → tokens) for this source in the usage settings `usage.sources`. Windows and filters are changed there too.
